context: ATM-OPT-001 benchmark tooling development. Recorded for transparency; none of these runs produced published performance or scientific evidence.
policy: A failed tooling run is not a measurement. Corrected code was rebuilt, every section of every binary was smoke-exercised, and only the completed identified run in evidence/measurements informs RESULTS.md.

failures.symptom: Generated JSON nested a summary object inside a numeric field (per_call_ns written with j.add instead of j.raw), so the runner could not parse the first original benchmark document.
failures.resolution: Corrected serialization in benchmark.cpp; rebuilt; smoke-verified all sections.

failures.symptom: Object-valued sections (locality_keys, replay by-thread rows) were emitted without member names, producing malformed JSON at the recorded byte offset.
failures.resolution: Corrected member-name emission in benchmark.cpp; rebuilt; smoke-verified all sections.

failures.symptom: The invalidate section constructed a second provider from an empty kernel vector and aborted with 'no SPICE kernels supplied'.
failures.resolution: Uses the real experiment Environment::make_kernels(c) kernel set; the observation survives its originating provider only by refcount. Also corrected a stale comment claiming the cross-provider check itself changes the generation (it does not: those exact paths are already loaded, so only refcounts change).

failures.symptom: Read-only review of the harness identified five tooling defects before any published measurement: thread-local replay capacity loss for thread counts other than 1/2/4; cold replay initial state mismatching the warmed measured batches; a UTC 'miss path' workload that stayed within one civil date; unavailable original diagnostics reported as zeros; scientific driver and CASE input files missing from provenance hashes.
failures.resolution: Replay thread counts restricted to 1/2/4; replay warm state seeded from the first recorded request; UTC miss workload now cycles exact distinct civil dates prepared outside timing; original counters sourced from an identified original diagnostic binary and unavailable values emitted as null; experiment, bench support, scenario loader and CASE-A/B/C files hashed before and after the run.

not_treated_as_evidence: evidence/benchmarks and evidence/benchmarks-complete directories were removed after the corrected complete run replaced them; retained evidence is only evidence/measurements.
